title: Shooting a bishop
html_source:
Ulysses Annotated: Revised and Expanded Edition
By Don Gifford, Robert J. Seidman has this as sexual intercourse with the woman in the superior position, but to me it sound more like slang for ejaculation. Zoe then corrects Lynch and says it was only a dry rush.
